scalarControl: Unchanged scalar forward in the candidate binary, with selected-prefix snapshot/restore in the transaction harness. This is not a separate main executable measurement.
timingBoundary: Complete target-only transaction wall/GPU time; all candidate rows executed, selected prefix committed. No draft network and no emitted-token decode rate.
prefillProfile: scratch2048, managed chunk2048, FP32 matrix/grouped experts/chunked DeltaNet, fused-all prefill and fused-FP32 decode attention in both arms; state rebuilt for every request.
resourceBoundary: New whole-system swapout per request including its zero-cache prefill. Metal is currentAllocatedSize sampled after the request, not a continuous driver/submission residency peak.
